name: MinUI
notes: MinUI has no extension filter. Every file of a Roms folder that is not hidden is listed as a game (os workspace/all/minui/minui.c:475-535,615-680), so the rows carry no extensions.

A Roms folder starts the pak named by the text inside its last parentheses, or by its whole name without parentheses (getEmuName, os workspace/all/common/utils.c:74-96). The pak is found at .system/<PLATFORM>/paks/Emus/<TAG>.pak then Emus/<PLATFORM>/<TAG>.pak.
BIOS sits in Bios/<TAG>/, two levels under the card root, so the roms root is ../../Roms from it.
SDCARD_PATH differs per device (/mnt/SDCARD, /mnt/sdcard, /storage/roms, /sdcard, /media/roms, /storage/TF2). Roms sits under it.
